The '''XA203 auxiliary grenade launcher''' was an [[under-barrel grenade launcher]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and sold for 2000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The weapon attachment was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
